source_envelope.embedding_text: text only; metadata and audit are not embedded

evidence_contract.source_id: Must resolve to one delivered corpus record. URLs and snapshot provenance come from that record metadata.
evidence_contract.start_char: Inclusive Python Unicode code-point offset into delivered source text.
evidence_contract.end_char: Exclusive Python Unicode code-point offset into delivered source text.
evidence_contract.source_text_sha256: Detects changes to the source before mapping or scoring.
evidence_contract.evidence_sha256: Detects changes to the exact selected span.
evidence_contract.archived_offsets: Retained only in audit/alignment_v06/evidence_span_mapping.json, with the original source representation.

related_reference_contract.relation_type: Explicit mention only; never infer same cause, fix, or version applicability.
related_reference_contract.unresolved_target: Keep number and status; do not invent an index source ID for held-out or absent records.

evaluation_contract.base_cases: 15 development + 15 test; original user reports unchanged
evaluation_contract.missing_information: Evaluator-only structured discriminating questions; empty list is valid for bounded answerable cases.
evaluation_contract.history_variants: Six explicit fixtures, same split and family as their base case; do not double-count as independent cases.
evaluation_contract.multi_turn: Ten staged scenarios; follow-up is released only after response 1 is recorded.
evaluation_contract.source_usage: Eight separate evidence-role and retrieval tasks; not held-out issue-resolution tests.
evaluation_contract.workflow_events: Local tracker integration specifications still require an adapter and actual system execution.

chunk_contract.mapping_helper: scripts/map_evidence_to_chunks.py maps supplied chunks and reports interval coverage; no real chunks have been built.
